## Why this index exists

The latest clean GSC check separated internal monitoring and URL-like probe traffic from real buyer queries. The raw export contained 500 rows, 4,147 impressions and 0 clicks. After filtering internal/monitoring pollution, the buyer-query subset contained 384 rows, 1,097 impressions, 0 clicks and an average position of 59.5.

The useful next action is not to publish more generic pages. The useful action is to route the existing buyer signals to the strongest official MUGE pages, RFQ paths and supplier-review pages.

## Buyer brief fields to keep consistent

For these query clusters, buyers should prepare the same core RFQ fields before asking for a quote:

- Product category, dimensions and packed weight.
- Packaging structure under review.
- Quantity range, with 500 units per design as the general MUGE low-MOQ reference.
- Material, finish, print coverage and insert or protection needs.
- Artwork status and sample goal.
- Destination market, sales channel and any document questions.
